about_the_game:
My name is Kuri Rose, and I am not a weapon.

Their world is slowly disappearing... one girl stands in defiance of the eternal void.

The Last Rose is an apocalypse adventure visual novel about Kuri Rose, friend to some, sister to another, weapon to everyone else. After her untimely death, she finds herself stuck in the middle of an apocalypse led by her ex-boyfriend's brother.

Embark on an adventure that spans across time alongside a large cast of interesting and varied characters.

At the end of the world, will you be able to defy the inevitable?

🌹 A Sprawling Story: The Last Rose spans over 100,000 words long. Sink your teeth into this hearty tale of the world's end - but first, play the 10,000 word long demo.

🌹 Multiple Endings: Play through three distinct routes in the full game, one of which features a romantic relationship, while the others tell stories of family, friends, and people once loved.

🌹 Gorgeous Original Art: Lose yourself in the striking visuals that bring the story to life by the fantastic Miyukiko and ombobon.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU with at least 1 GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 6450)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / Apple M1 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with at least 1 GB VRAM (e.g., Intel Iris Plus Graphics 645 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: The Last Rose Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with at least 1 GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
